title: test-before-done emits an unrecognized output shape ({ values: { system } }) — the advisory is silently dropped on every TaskUpdate; the hook is a registered no-op

evidence.quote: * Advisory only -- uses values.system message injection, no permissionDecision.

observe_how: The repo's own PreToolUse output schema (schemas.md) defines hookSpecificOutput / continue / stopReason / systemMessage / suppressOutput — there is no `values.system` field anywhere in the contract, so Claude Code ignores the object. The hook IS registered (repo .claude/settings.json matcher TaskUpdate, line 126-133) and its state writer test-run-tracker exists and is registered, so the whole pipeline runs end-to-end and then throws the warning away. Net effect: the 'no completion claims without test evidence' guard documented in RULES.md has zero runtime teeth from this hook. One-line fix: rename `values.system` to top-level `systemMessage` (user-visible) or use hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason with 'ask'.
telemetry: Mark any task completed without running tests — no warning appears in the session despite log.info firing in hook logs.

title: hook-health-monitor emits hook_health_ratio with spanId falling back to the Claude session UUID — feedback likely attaches to a nonexistent Braintrust span (consistent with corr-null 60.7%); active registration also omits a timeout
causal_links: candidate contributor to corr-null 60.7% from harvest SUMMARY

title: tree-invalidate: root-level depth heuristic is separator-dependent and wrong for absolute paths — forward-slash Windows paths (depth=1 when split on path.sep '\\') make EVERY .ts/.py edit 'significant', backslash paths make the branch dead

evidence.quote: // Any new TypeScript/Python module file at root level

causal_links: amplifies D2e-06 (more invalidation writes -> more chances to race/corrupt the tree file)
observe_how: tool_input.file_path is always absolute. On Windows path.sep='\\': a 'C:/Users/...' forward-slash path splits into 1 segment (depth 1 <= 4 -> always significant -> tree marked stale on every TS/Py edit anywhere); a 'C:\\Users\\...' path is always >4 segments (branch never fires, contradicting the 'root level' intent). Compute depth relative to CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR after normalizing separators.
telemetry: _invalidated_at churn rate in .claude/knowledge-tree.json vs actual significant edits

title: pageindex-watch: trailing-edge debounce never fires — the final batch of indexed-doc edits is never reindexed until some LATER indexed edit arrives (possibly days later or from another project), leaving PageIndex stale by design

evidence.quote:
const elapsed = now - pending.timestamp;
  if (elapsed >= DEBOUNCE_MS) {

observe_how: First edit creates pending (elapsed=0 < 2000ms) and exits; the trigger only runs on a SUBSEQUENT indexed-file edit. A session that edits ROADMAP.md once and stops never reindexes it. The 2s window also means nearly every second edit triggers a full background `uv run ... batch_index` spawn (uv startup is the known 13-17s class, SEED-08), so the debounce neither batches well nor flushes reliably. A detached setTimeout-flush child or SessionEnd flush closes the hole.
telemetry: compare mtime of indexed docs vs pageindex_* rows; count of orphaned pageindex-pending.json entries
